definition: Redoubtable means formidable; commanding fear and respect.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word redoubtable. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know redoubtable should be able to work it out from your sentence.

Fearsome says feared, full stop — a fearsome storm, a fearsome temper — and any respect is optional. Redoubtable braids the two strands together: you dread the contest precisely because you rate the opponent so highly. Imposing works at first sight — the scale or bearing that daunts before any contest begins: a doorman, a courthouse, a six-foot trophy case. Redoubtable is earned the slow way, out of a record of contests won; a slight, soft-spoken chess master can be redoubtable without looking imposing for a second.
